name: AWS IoT Core
tagline: Managed cloud service for connecting IoT devices via MQTT, HTTP, and WebSockets
description: AWS IoT Core is a managed cloud service that lets connected devices interact with cloud applications and other devices. It supports MQTT, HTTPS, and MQTT over WebSockets, device shadows, jobs, fleets, and a full HTTP control-plane API for managing things, certificates, rules, and more.

auth.details: AWS Signature Version 4 (SigV4) with IAM credentials or temporary credentials from STS; devices may use X.509 certificates for MQTT/data plane

pricing.free_tier_limits: Accounts created before July 15, 2025: for 12 months, 2.25M connection minutes, 500k messages, 225k Registry/Device Shadow operations, 250k rules triggered, and 250k actions applied monthly. New customers receive up to $200 in credits; the free plan lasts up to 6 months.

rate_limits: Published per-account, per-region quotas vary by API and region. Current defaults include 10 TPS for ListThings and 10 TPS for DescribeEndpoint; some quotas are adjustable.
use_cases: list IoT things in an account
create a thing and attach a certificate
publish a message to an MQTT topic
list IoT jobs for a fleet
